display.title: Affixed and Dangerous
display.subtitle: Slay your first Apotheosis boss
description: Apotheosis spawns rare §5bosses§r — affixed elite mobs with a boss bar, a
name, and a fistful of deadly affixes. They drop gear, gems, and rare loot.
Hunt one down and put it in the ground. §7(Any affixed Apotheosis boss
counts — they appear more often in dungeons and the deeper dimensions.)

kill_apoth_boss.description: Slay an Apotheosis boss (detected on kill).
